kind.doc: What opening shows it: a door of the UI (Docs/features/22-progression.md §3) or a book of research (§4).

target.doc: Which door or book. A door: research, build, heroes, relics, store, world, knowledge, banner, survey. A book: Civics, Warfare, Magic, Sagas, Atlas.

text.doc: One short paragraph: what it is and what the player does with it. Four lines at most.

icon.doc: Art file stem in src/render/assets, drawn large over the turning rays.
